credits.title: Oldeupe
credits.overview: The story takes place in a small town in France that no one ever talks about: doctors who are not being replaced, shops that are closing, residents who are doing their best to get by. Ordinary, endearing people, sometimes clumsy, sometimes a little out of touch... but deeply human.

credits.title: Kaamelott: The Second Chapter (Part II)
credits.overview: Third and final film in the Kaamelott franchise.

credits.title: Kaamelott: The Second Chapter (Part I)
credits.overview: After reclaiming Kaamelott from Lancelot's tyrannical rule, Arthur spares his life, defying Celtic gods. Knights must prove themselves for Table Round seats while Arthur faces new threats as king.

credits.title: Haroun - Seuls
credits.overview: Seuls is a show about us, about what we hide, what we deny, and what we pretend not to see. There are no taboos and no moral lessons, just an observation of the absurdities that surround us.

credits.title: Sweet Sixty
credits.overview: At sixty years old, two friends in financial difficulties are going to take advantage of their image in the fashion and advertising world. One is still beautiful, the other never was. But beyond the game of appearances, what does it really mean to be of retirement age today?

credits.title: For Better and for Worse
credits.overview: Jean has been the conservative mayor of a small town for several years. He intends to run for another term. Edith, his wife, is the paragon of the traditional devoted housewife and mother. So it comes as quite a shock when she tells her husband of forty years that deep down, she has always been... A MAN! credits.title: Haroun
credits.overview: In this playfully provocative set, French comedian Haroun examines modern society - and wonders if humans have stopped evolving.

credits.title: Just Like a Woman
credits.overview: Éléonore Berthier, 34 years old, keeps living as a teenager, collecting odd jobs and one night stands. Following a burnout, her mother and sister decide to take action to help her make a fresh start.

credits.title: Haroun - Les inédits de la tournée
Selfie
credits.overview: In a world where digital technology has invaded our lives, some of us end up cracking. Addict or technophobe, with family or at school, at work or in love, SELFIE tells the comic and wild destinies of Homo Numericus on the verge of a nervous breakdown.

credits.title: Haroun - Internet Etc.
credits.overview: If you’re reading this, it means you’re on the Internet. This show is too. One year after his special election show, Haroun returns for three exclusive dates focused on the theme of the Internet and new technologies.

credits.title: In the Game
credits.overview: A rebellious teenager must travel the country with his sick grandpa to get to his basketball game.
